name: Chat Completions
description: Access 66 frontier LLMs with OpenAI-compatible API. Price depends on model and token usage.

model.description: Model ID to use for completion

name: Anthropic Messages
description: Anthropic-shaped Messages API. Send Claude-style requests (system + messages array, tools, tool_choice) and BlockRun routes them through the right upstream provider. Token-priced like /chat/completions.

model.description: Anthropic model id (or any BlockRun-routable Anthropic alias).

system.description: System prompt — string, or array of { type: 'text', text }.

stream.description: Server-Sent Events stream of Anthropic-style deltas.

name: OpenAI Responses API
description: OpenAI-shaped Responses API — the native protocol for Codex CLI and agents that need tools + reasoning on gpt-5.x. Same body shape as api.openai.com/v1/responses; token-priced like /chat/completions. Stateless gateway: store:false is enforced and previous_response_id / conversation / background are rejected — resend full context per call and use include: ["reasoning.encrypted_content"] for reasoning continuity.

model.description: OpenAI model id (gpt-5.x, o-series, codex; with or without the openai/ prefix).

input.description: String, or array of Responses input items (messages, function_call_output, reasoning replays, …).

max_output_tokens.description: Maximum tokens to generate (bounds the x402 quote).

stream.description: Server-Sent Events stream of native Responses events.

name: Grok Live Search
description: Real-time web and news search powered by xAI Grok with live data access.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results per source

name: Image Generation
description: Generate images with GPT Image 1, ChatGPT Images 2.0, Nano Banana, or Grok Imagine.

prompt.description: Text description of the image to generate

name: Image-to-Image Edit
description: Edit or vary an existing image with a text prompt. Send the source image (and optional mask) as a base64 data URI. OpenAI gpt-image-1 / gpt-image-2 support mask-based inpainting; Google nano-banana / nano-banana-pro do prompt-only edits (mask not supported).

image.description: Source image(s) as base64 data URI(s). Pass a single string, or an array (OpenAI-compatible image[]) to fuse multiple sources — e.g. a reference image + a brand logo. Max 4 for OpenAI, 3 for Google. Multi-image cannot be combined with mask.

mask.description: Optional mask as base64 data URI; transparent pixels mark the editable region. OpenAI models only — rejected for Google models.

name: Music Generation
description: Generate music tracks with Minimax Music 2.5 / 2.5+. Provide a text prompt describing the song; optionally supply lyrics or set instrumental=true. Price scales with duration.

prompt.description: High-level description of the song (genre, mood, instrumentation).

lyrics.description: Optional song lyrics. Ignored when instrumental=true.

instrumental.description: If true, generate an instrumental track.

name: Text-to-Speech (ElevenLabs)
description: Synthesize speech from text with ElevenLabs (Flash v2.5 for real-time agents, Multilingual v2 / Eleven v3 for narration). Billed per input character; the exact price is quoted in the 402. Returns a hosted MP3 URL.

voice.description: Voice alias (e.g. sarah, george) or raw ElevenLabs voice_id.

name: Sound Effects (ElevenLabs)
description: Generate a cinematic sound effect from a text prompt (up to 22s). Flat price per generation.

name: List Voices (free)
description: List available ElevenLabs voices and their aliases for use with /v1/audio/speech. Free.

name: Submit Video Generation Job
description: Submit an async video generation job with OpenAI Sora 2 (via Azure AI Foundry), xAI Grok Imagine, or ByteDance Seedance (1.5 Pro / 2.0 Fast / 2.0 Pro). Billed per second. Returns `{ id, poll_url }` in ~3-20s with payment verified but NOT settled. Poll GET /api/v1/videos/generations/{id} with the same x-payment header until status=completed — settlement fires on that poll. If upstream fails or you never poll, you are not charged.

prompt.description: Text description of the video to generate

image_url.description: Optional seed image URL for image-to-video. Mutually exclusive with real_face_asset_id.

real_face_asset_id.description: Optional BytePlus RealFace asset id (format `ta_xxxxxxxx`) for consistent real-person character video. Only Seedance 2.0 / 2.0-fast support it. Get the id from the RealFace enrollment flow (see /docs/video/real-person-ip). Mutually exclusive with image_url.

last_frame_url.description: Optional final-frame seed image for first-and-last-frame interpolation. Requires image_url and a Seedance model.

reference_image_urls.description: Optional Seedance 2.0 omni / multi-reference images. Mutually exclusive with image_url, last_frame_url, and real_face_asset_id.

input_type.description: Optional explicit mode assertion. If provided, it must match the seed fields: text=no seed inputs, image=image_url or real_face_asset_id, first_last_frame=image_url+last_frame_url, reference=reference_image_urls.

reference_videos.description: Optional Seedance 2.0 reference-to-video (r2v / multimodal_reference): up to 3 reference video clips that condition the generation. Its own mode — mutually exclusive with image_url, last_frame_url, reference_image_urls, and real_face_asset_id.

reference_audios.description: Optional Seedance 2.0 reference audio (multimodal_reference): up to 3 reference audio clips, each ≤15.2s. Same mode as reference_videos.

duration_seconds.description: Duration billed for (defaults to model default)

name: Exa Web Search
description: Neural and keyword web search powered by Exa. Optional category filter: company, research paper, news, pdf, github, tweet, personal site, linkedin profile, financial report.

category.description: Optional category filter (company, research paper, news, pdf, github, tweet, personal site, linkedin profile, financial report).

name: Exa Find Similar
description: Find pages semantically similar to a given URL.

url.description: Source URL to find pages similar to.

name: Multi-chain RPC
description: JSON-RPC 2.0 passthrough across 40+ chains (powered by Tatum). Swap `ethereum` in the path for any network — base, solana, polygon, bsc, arbitrum, optimism, avalanche, bitcoin, sui, and more: POST /api/v1/rpc/{network}. One endpoint, every chain, no API key. $0.004 per call; a JSON-RPC batch is priced per element.

method.description: Chain RPC method — e.g. eth_blockNumber, eth_call, eth_getBalance (EVM) or getSlot, getAccountInfo (Solana).

name: Exa Contents
description: Extract full text content from one or more URLs. Priced per URL ($0.002 each).

urls.description: List of URLs to extract content from. Price scales linearly: $0.002 × number of URLs.

name: Exa Answer

text.description: Include full text of cited pages in response.

name: Create Modal Sandbox

image.description: Managed image. Only python:3.11 is currently available.

cpu.description: CPU cores. CPU-only max is 1; GPU sandboxes can request up to 8.

memory.description: Memory in MB. CPU-only max is 1024; GPU sandboxes can request up to 16384.

gpu.description: Optional GPU type. Pricing replaces the CPU base price for the full sandbox lifetime.

name: Execute In Modal Sandbox

name: Terminate Modal Sandbox

name: Initiate AI Voice Call
description: Place an outbound AI conversation call via Bland.ai. The agent calls the recipient and converses based on `task` (natural-language instructions). Requires `from` — a wallet-owned phone number provisioned via /api/v1/phone/numbers/buy. Returns a call_id immediately; poll GET /api/v1/voice/call/{call_id} for status, transcript, and recording.

to.description: Destination phone number in E.164 format, e.g. +14155552671.

task.description: Natural-language description of what the AI agent should do on the call.

from.description: Wallet-owned phone number used as caller ID (E.164). Required — purchase one via /api/v1/phone/numbers/buy first.

voice.description: Voice preset: nat, josh, maya, june, paige, derek, florian — or a Bland.ai voice ID.

first_sentence.description: Optional fixed opening line spoken before the AI takes over.

wait_for_greeting.description: If true, AI waits for the recipient to speak first.

interruption_threshold.description: How aggressive the AI is about interrupting (ms).

name: Provision Phone Number (30-day lease)
description: Lease a US or Canadian phone number for 30 days, wallet-bound. Auto-registered with Bland on purchase so it can be used as outbound caller-ID via /api/v1/voice/call. Twilio purchase runs before settlement — failed Twilio purchases are not charged.

country.description: ISO country code: US or CA.

areaCode.description: Optional preferred 3-digit area code (availability not guaranteed).

name: Renew Phone Number Lease
description: Extend an existing wallet-owned number lease by 30 days.

phoneNumber.description: Number to renew (E.164, must be owned by the calling wallet).

name: List Wallet-Owned Phone Numbers
description: Return all active numbers leased to the calling wallet. Tiny x402 charge confirms wallet identity.

name: Release Phone Number
description: Release a wallet-owned number back to the Twilio pool. Free, but still goes through x402 so the wallet identity is verified.

phoneNumber.description: Number to release (E.164, must be owned by the calling wallet).

name: Phone Number Carrier Lookup
description: Look up carrier and line type (landline / mobile / VoIP) for any phone number via Twilio Lookup.

name: Phone Number Fraud Lookup
description: Carrier + fraud signals (SIM swap, call forwarding) via Twilio Lookup. Useful for KYC and account-takeover defenses.
